verdict.rationale: Ollama's own docs explicitly claim you can 'Run larger models on Ollama's Cloud without the download,' directly matching the story, and this is reinforced by the llms.txt description of running models 'locally or in the cloud.' However, this is vendor-claimed documentation with no independent/community evidence confirming the cloud offload experience, and most community discussion focuses on local performance issues, so real-world validation is thin.
